evidence.performance: council mobile pass is performance 0.73 / LCP 5459ms / CLS 0 against the 0.90 / 2500ms / 0.10 floor (desktop 0.82 / 607ms). The 5459ms does not reproduce: six re-runs on the same preset gave simLCP 2869-2884ms uncompressed, and 2105ms with gzip, which is what production actually serves (Cloudflare, content-encoding: gzip, 58,535 bytes). tb ship measures against an ungzipped static server and is therefore ~760ms pessimistic. Largest real lever is 128KB of incompressible preloaded woff2 on the critical path, worth -720ms measured. clip-path costs 0ms: Chrome logged the h1 LCP entry at 128ms while it was clipped to zero height. Held below 7 because 0.73 is the recorded performance score and no re-run produced a replacement for it.

The shard sphere is the best thing here in full-1440.png, but scene.js line 30 runs canvas.remove() under prefers-reduced-motion, so reduced-motion-1440.png is a bare black field with centred type: a direct failure of the reduced-motion standard (gentle, do not delete), with the same path used as the WebGL catch fallback. hero-line-in also animates clip-path:inset over 1.4s on the LCP element, failing transform-and-opacity-only and gating first contentful headline paint behind 1.79s of decoration.
